title: Noah The Black and White Zoo (EN)

slides.title: Cover
slides.transcript: [warmly] The Black and White Zoo. <break time="0.4s" /> A book for Noah. Nine bold animals to look at together. Are you ready, Noah? <break time="0.5s" /> [warmly] Let's turn the page.

slides.title: Goodnight
slides.transcript: [warmly] Goodnight. <break time="0.4s" /> Goodnight zebra, goodnight panda, goodnight owl in the tree. Goodnight, Noah. <break time="0.5s" /> [whispers] Sleep well, little one.

slides.title: Rainbow
slides.transcript: [warmly] All the colours. <break time="0.4s" /> Red, yellow, blue, green, orange, purple, pink, brown, grey, <break time="0.3s" /> white, black, turquoise, gold, sand and light green. All of them together. <break time="0.5s" /> [whispers] Goodnight, Noah.
